verbs.name: connect
verbs.description: Link a project to its vault. Infers slug, type, and status, confirms one card of required fields, applies with a receipt. Idempotent.

verbs.name: sync
verbs.description: Push project state to the vault: refresh the brief, mirror the handoff, update the project index row.

verbs.name: check
verbs.description: Read-only health report for the project and vault, including schema drift. [vault|repo|all] also audits repo structure. Never writes.

verbs.name: sitrep
verbs.description: Plain-language orientation after a break: where you left off, what is done, where the vault is, and what to do next. Read-only.

verbs.name: clean
verbs.description: Cleanup sweep: indexes, wikilink form, updated dates, off-schema frontmatter. Previews then applies, and never creates a vault file. --deep adds the structural pass. [vault|repo|all] adds repo symlinks.

verbs.name: dream
verbs.description: Semantic refresh, the deepest tier: surfaces stale, superseded, redundant, or orphaned content as scored candidates you judge before anything changes. --folder scopes the walk to one subtree.

verbs.name: draw
verbs.description: Create a canvas, base, or mermaid diagram, either hand-authored or generated from vault data.

verbs.name: board
verbs.description: Scaffold a self-hosted kanban seeded from tasks/: drag to move, saved to disk. Re-seeding keeps your dragged cards. Use --project SLUG or --all.

verbs.name: advisor
verbs.description: Toggle the proactive advisor (visible flag in the breadcrumb + AGENTS.md marker), or run its read-only context pulse.

verbs.name: kebab
verbs.description: Slugify a title into kebab-case, or --scan a project for filenames whose title breaks the vault-standards §4 naming rule. Read-only; never renames.
